notes_for_editor: Fate is solid: four sources say it burned in 2015, and the FFLA list says Tower Gone. Construction is less certain. Two sites give 1929 for the cabin and crow's nest, and a 1928 newspaper item quoted on Forest Lookouts names 'Jay peak' among new Lolo forest structures without naming this site; the story uses 1929 and flags the item. The 1955 tower date is from three sources. Nothing found on what remains at the site or whether it is open to visitors, so access is omitted. Staff names are left out on purpose. Brief record checked: status gone, design L-4, 12.5 m (41 ft) and Clearwater NF all agree with sources. The brief's county 'Idaho' was not checked against a source and was left alone.
